responsibility: Implements GCC’s main RTL region scheduler and pass entry points for sched1, sched2, live-range shrinkage, and scheduling fusion. It discovers scheduling regions, manages per-region block order and candidate source blocks for interblock motion, drives dependency and priority computation, coordinates block scheduling across a region, and selects between ordinary scheduling, EBB scheduling, selective scheduling, or fusion modes through RTL pass wrappers. This file is the principal scheduling front end, above the generic mechanics in haifa-sched.cc.
